title: Stuthiyu – Srastha 3 Devadas Mungamuri Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: స్తుతియు మహిమయు నీకే – క్షితికిన్‌ దివికిన్‌ నీటి
హితుడా మా ప్రేమ నీ – కెట్లు చూపుదును
english: Stuthiyu Mahimayu neeke – kshithikin divikin neeti
hithudaa maa prema nee – ketlu choopudhunu
intro: Stuthiyu is the old classic christian Telugu worship single written and composed by Shri. Devadas Mungamuri, sung by Nithya Mammen, music composed by Prabhu Pammi and produced by Jeeva R Pakerla added this song in his recent album project, Srastha 3. This song video was released on November 05, 2021 through Jeeva R Pakerla YouTube channel.
